_why: The rules of tools/content-screen.mjs, the public-repo content screen (corrective directive CD-27, CD-07, CD-08; Tools, 2026-11-07). The repository is public, so a push must not carry a personal path, a secret, a console SDK path, a franchise word in what ships, a gold-haired fighter (Legal RL-014) or a public sentence that is not true. Every rule is data: a change to a word list is a change to this file, reviewed by Legal for the words. 'fail' stops the push's check; 'warn' is printed and counted but does not fail (a line that someone else owns and has not yet changed).

profilePath._about: a user-profile path: Windows C:\Users\<name> (any slash form), macOS /Users/<name>, Linux /home/<name>. The placeholder words below are not a person.

consoleSdk._about: paths and names that only a console SDK installation or a platform's NDA tooling carries

franchise._about: Legal's franchise words (docs/legal/never-use-words.md, name-longlist stage 0): in what SHIPS or is shown to the public. The notes in docs/ (the screening records, Legal's own lists, the vision file) name them on purpose and are outside this scope.

rl014._about: Legal RL-014 (docs/legal/review-log.md): no golden hair as a power cue. The shipped fighter files' hair colours must not read as gold or yellow (hue 38 to 65 degrees, saturation over 0.45, value over 0.55).

publicWords._about: Public sentences that must not come back (CD-08): README.md and CLAUDE.md. README.md is held to Legal's RL-171 words; CLAUDE.md's 'open source' line is the EP's and warns until it is changed.

phrases.why: Legal RL-171: a promise to fix the flashing scenes is untrue while the flash work is paused
Legal's never-use list: 'open source' for the whole project is a claim the record does not support while no licence is chosen
the public web build uses a custom engine build; 'official' is not true of it
